patho.caption_source: Transvaginal ultrasound showing a cross-section of a bicornuate uterus , with two cavities or "horns" visible at left and right, respectively. In the "horn" to the right, a gestational sac is visible, with a diameter of 5.7mm, corresponding to a gestational age of between 4 and 5 weeks.
